resp:
Reference study complete. Evidence is on disk; no repo involved, no source touched.

WHAT THE REFERENCE ACTUALLY IS
OFFF Montréal — a design/art/digital-culture festival homepage (OFFF Sept 2–3 + FORUM Sept 4, 2026).
Nuxt 3 + Tailwind, DatoCMS content, Mux video, one stylesheet pair. The homepage is a SINGLE 100dvh
screen (measured 1440x1397), not a scrolling multi-section page:

  main.min-h-screen
   +- div.page > .page-inner
       +- header#header   absolute, z-50, h-header-height = 96px, inverted white-on-black
       +- .page-content
       |   +- HERO  bg-black text-white, min-h-dvh lg:h-dvh
       |   |   +- div.px-gutter.grid.h-full  4x4 mobile / 6 cols md / lg:grid-cols-[repeat(var(--num-cols),auto)]
       |   +- div.container-main.mt-auto.justify-end  -> h1 + "Discover the lineup" -> /lineup/
       +- footer.container-main  -> newsletter (h3 + OFFF/FORUM radios) + links + socials + "Website by REF®"

Real values read out of shipped code, not guessed:
- Palette: red #ee3338, black #000, white #fff, grey #c5c5c5. Red is the only chromatic value.
- Type: Baikal 600 (sans) + Forvm 400 (serif) — and every heading ships as a PAIR,
  --text-hN-{desktop|mobile}-{offf|forum}. The OFFF/FORUM duality is a typographic dual-mode in the
  token layer, not a colour theme (h1 offf 8rem/600/-.04em vs forum 7.6rem/400/-.02em).
- Rhythm: --spacing-gutter .4rem base; radii --radius 20px, --box-radius 100px (pill), --check-radius 50%.
- 19 speaker tiles, each with its own --cover-ratio (0.5625 … 1) so the mosaic is intentionally ragged,
  each revealing its caption on hover (top-[calc(50%+var(--cover-ratio)*50%)], opacity-0 -> visible).

TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE AUTOMATED PROBES (important, they change the build)
1. The motion profile reads "0 videos, 0 @keyframes, none in static HTML, taxonomy: dashboard".
   That is a JS-injected undercount plus a mis-taxonomy. The static probe fetched 0 stylesheets and
   counted 28 transitions; the real CSS has 65. And this is not a dashboard — the "6 form controls"
   are the cookie-consent manager (4 checkboxes) plus 2 newsletter radios.
2. The reference ANIMATES, and heavily. Grounded in the real bundles:
   - <html class="lenis"> -> Lenis smooth scroll
   - main[style="--scroll:0px"] -> JS writes scroll into a custom property consumed by
     .page-leave-active .page-inner{transform:translateY(calc(var(--scroll)*-1))}
   - page transition: .page-leave-to{opacity:.5;transform:scale(.9) translateY(5vw)} with an overlay at
     .6s cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1) scaling 1.1 -> 1
   - a 4-curve easing system: expo cubic-bezier(.87,0,.13,1), quart cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1),
     power2Out cubic-bezier(.32,.94,.6,1), default cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)/.15s
   - 51 distinct .mp4 promo loops (Mux) + 12 GIFs in the CMS payload feeding the tiles; 0 @keyframes,
     so all motion is transitions + scroll vars + video, never keyframes.
   A static rebuild of this reference would be a failed build.

EVIDENCE (in the turn's artifacts dir, published automatically)
- reference.md — full text/asset/motion inventory, tile-by-tile caption/slug/ratio/asset table
- design.md — the distilled spec: structure, nav model, type scale, palette, spacing, radii,
  component inventory, imagery direction, motion
- reference.png — full-page 1440x1397 (harness-measured; I re-scraped nothing and let the background
  capture serve the turn, and I have no vision tool this session, so I did not visually interpret it —
  every layout fact above comes from the hydrated DOM, the real CSS and the CMS payload)
- _reference-capture/ — reference.html hydrated DOM, inventory.json, asset-manifest.json, downloads.json, 70 assets

SUGGESTIONS FOR THE BUILD
- Build the hero as one 100dvh justified mosaic with runtime column count and per-tile aspect ratios —
  that ragged justified grid is the identity of the page; a uniform 3-col card grid would miss it.
- Keep the dual-mode typography concept (a heavy tight sans voice + a lighter serif voice) but NOT the
  faces: Baikal and Forvm are licensed commercial fonts and are not redistributable.
- Ship the four motion mechanisms from day one (Lenis, scroll-linked page transition, tile video/GIF,
  the easing system) — retrofitting them later means rewriting the layout.
- Replace all 70 media assets and all copy; none of OFFF's artwork, photography or voice is ours to reuse.
- Tokens come from atlas's brand kit, not from offforum.com's hex values — I'd bridge #ee3338 et al. into
  semantic tokens so nothing ships as a hardcoded brand value.

BLOCKER: this venture has no repo linked (Settings -> Venture -> Technical -> Repo URL is empty), and
/opt/yvon-hermes-http is not a git repository. So there is nothing to check out and I can't scaffold the
frontend yet — I also did not guess a path or touch GitHub, per your rules. Link the repo (and point me at
atlas's brand kit) and I can execute immediately.

ONE QUESTION BEFORE I BUILD
CLONE — same structure, our content? or ADAPT — reinterpreted for our brand?

Worth saying plainly: you asked for an exact clone, and an exact clone is not something I can ship — it
would reproduce OFFF's copy, their licensed typefaces and their 70 third-party media assets. In your
protocol, CLONE means replicating the structure, layout and sections exactly while replacing all text and
images with novizio's own content and brand. If you pick CLONE that is what you get; say the word if you
actually wanted something else and I'll scope it.
